title: Project-agnostic Controller governance injection and readiness
description: The Controller must inject and verify its complete governance envelope before accepting work. Missing, placeholder, incomplete, or tampered gates produce a typed blocked receipt. This contract does not admit a worker, activate a wave, or bind project intent.

readiness_rules.ready: READY_TO_ACCEPT_WORK requires all required gates verified, governance_sha256 non-null, failure_code null, and work acceptance remains a separate typed receipt.
readiness_rules.blocked: BLOCKED requires governance_sha256 null, no verified gates, WORK_REJECTED, and a typed failure code.
readiness_rules.ordering: injection_order=1 is mandatory; Bootstrap handoff validation is the next transition and may not precede this readiness receipt.
readiness_rules.side_effects: Readiness verification is compiler-only and cannot mutate Product state, use credentials/providers, activate work, or admit incomplete roles.
